result.summary: Found 2 layout issues in the 'Popular right now' and restaurant list sections.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' information block has overlapping text where '25–30 min' and 'delivery' are partially merged or incorrectly layered with the restaurant name details.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or margins of the text container for the restaurant's metadata to prevent overlap and improve readability.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' card, the 'delivery' and 'Ramen' text elements are rendered too close to the restaurant name, leading to poor visual hierarchy.
issues.suggestion: Increase the vertical spacing between the restaurant name and the delivery time/category tags.
